newCodeRationale: No shortlisted donor implements KnowKit capacity quotas, PostgreSQL guards or isolated OCR resource accounting. New development-only orchestration reuses the repository's migrated catalog, lexical/vector, disclosure, outbox and purge adapters. No donor scores are reported as measurements.

localAdaptations.reason: Measured full-corpus lexical warm p95 exceeded 500 ms. Cache one schema-validation result bound to both current PostgreSQL JSON bytes SHA-256 and the declared immutable manifest digest. Continue querying current scoped snapshot/generation on every search and checking authoritative lifecycle/access before disclosure; changed bytes/digest and disclosure after a post-cache committed revoke have negative regressions. No authorization or result caching.

Full reference persistence exposed simultaneous legacy 4 MiB and approved 16 MiB guards on manifest_json. Remove only the obsolete smaller guard; retain the existing 16 MiB guard. Positive SQL above 4 MiB and negative SQL above 16 MiB bind the approved wire ceiling without changing deployed migration checksums.

Full-scale guarded fixture loading exposed quadratic tenant scans in block and snapshot-member identity lookups. Non-unique indexes retain existing predicates and invariants; indexed and forced-linear query-plan counterfactuals execute on the full corpus.

A 10000-source manifest exceeds the generic 1 MiB decoder default but fits the approved 16 MiB index-manifest schema. Use the existing schema-bound decoder, preserving schema/semantic/identity validation; full-size positive and oversized negative regressions bind the boundary.
